feature_name: Skipped file logging for agent-based transfers
summary: Cloud Logging for Storage Transfer Service now emits logs for files skipped during agent-based transfer jobs when a file already exists and the job is configured to ignore existing files.
extended_definition: Cloud Logging for Storage Transfer Service now emits logs for files skipped during agent-based transfer jobs when a file already exists and the job is configured to ignore existing files.

supporting_pages.title: "Transfer from a file system to Cloud Storage \_|\_ Storage Transfer Service\
evidence_snippets: Transfers from file systems to Cloud Storage are agent-based transfers, meaning you will install software agents on a machine with access to your file system to orchestrate the transfer.
